action.newText: HostExecutor.readFixOutcome selects the first non-empty trimmed line of fix.stderr. If there is no such line or it consists entirely of Unicode control characters (General Category Cc), return stderrLine: null without considering later lines. Otherwise pass the selected line through the unchanged sanitizeDiagnostic, then apply .slice(0, 200). An empty result is null.

rationale: A FIX-reader-only check satisfies AC-5 and preserves the existing 'fix not pushed' fallback without changing the shared sanitizer or AGENT behavior.

action.newText: For an unauthenticated visitor to a protected route, keep the existing login redirect when the access cookie is absent, upstream returns 401 or 403, or upstream returns 2xx without a user. An unavailable auth probe preserves session state and cookies; show the retryable 503 page only on a protected route when no user is loaded. Guest-only and invite behavior is unchanged.

rationale: This resolves the exclusive wording without reclassifying a successful no-user response as an outage or changing the established login flow.
